capabilities: Open the current note in DocWen
Export notes to Word, Excel, or Markdown
Proofread Markdown in an Obsidian sidebar
Add or remove Markdown heading numbering
disambiguation: Not a converter itself; all conversion, proofreading, and numbering work is done by the separate DocWen desktop app, and the plugin only connects to it.
extras: Windows and Linux desktop only; no mobile support. Documents stay local: a temporary copy of the selected file is given to DocWen, and existing output files or result folders are never overwritten. Manual updates must keep data.json to preserve settings.
problem: Obsidian cannot convert notes to Word or Excel, run DocWen's proofreader, or control the DocWen desktop app from inside the vault.

relations.evidence: The work is done by DocWen installed on your computer; this plugin is the connection between the two.

summary: Bridge to the local DocWen app that exports notes to Word, Excel, or Markdown, proofreads text, and adds or removes heading numbering.
